verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The sparq-solid manifest still declares exactly the six features listed by the new combined matrix leg, and Cargo feature unification makes this explicit comma-separated set equivalent to the crate's current all-features state. With test: true, the existing matrix runner executes the crate tests in that combined state, covering interactions that the isolated legs cannot. The golden leg-name entry matches the added leg and preserves ordering. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is present. Because the diff and findings are materially unchanged from round 1 (zero issues in both rounds), progress is stagnant under the required scale.
